name: Reinvestment Income Classification 2 Code
definition: Specifies the type of cash proceeds that the holder is eligible to reinvest.

CAPG.name: Capital Gains
CAPG.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as capital gains.

DVCA.name: Cash Dividend
DVCA.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as cash dividend.

CDPS.name: Cash Dividend Special
CDPS.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as special cash dividend.

INTR.name: Interest
INTR.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as interest.

LTCG.name: Long Term Capital Gains
LTCG.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as long term capital gains.

PRPL.name: Principal
PRPL.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as principal.

ROCA.name: Return Of Capital
ROCA.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as return of capital.

STCG.name: Short Term Capital Gains
STCG.definition: Cash proceeds being reinvested is classified as short term capital gains.
